"'''Zero Friends Again'''" is the sixth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''. The episode was written by [[Myung Joh Wesner]].<ref name="Zero Friends Again" />

{{Media-stub}}

==Official description==
''Relationships fray under the pressures of a difficult journey.''

==Plot summary==
===Escape===
After fleeing down the trapdoor, the [[Younglings|children]] [[Wim]], [[Fern]], [[Neel]] and [[KB]] slide down a tunnel which splits into several tubes at the base of a [[Skull Ridge Mountain|snow mountain]] The children exit out of the tubes. Neel notices that KB is not moving and alerts Wim and Fern. Fern explains that sometimes her [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] augmentations break down, preventing her from moving. Wim and Neel help Fern turn KB onto her side so they can reset the [[occipital link]] at the back of her [[Bone|skull]]

===An unexpected reunion===
Meanwhile, [[Jod Na Nawood]] exits a manhole covered with jewels and [[necklace]]s. He encounters the [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|hotel director]] and several guests. Unaware that they have been taken captive by the [[pirate]]s, he asks them to refuel his [[Starship|ship]]. However, Jod finds himself being held at gunpoint by [[Gunter]], who orders that he be taken [[prisoner]] Jod attempts to bribe the pirates with the promise of treasure below [[Skull Ridge Mountain]] but Gunter counters that he would be taken to [[Captain]] [[Brutus]]. A grinning [[Pokkit]] stands nearby. 

Jod attempts to convince his [[Silvo's pirates|former pirate crew]] that he can lead them to more treasure on [[At Attin]] but they ignore him. [[SM-33]] exits through the manhole to help Jod but is [[stun]]ned by the pirates. As Jod is led away, Pokkit taunts him about his capture and kisses him mockingly on the cheek. The [[Quarren]] pirate, [[Glerb]], spots several [[New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter]]s, which begin strafing the pirates. The pirates flee with Jod and SM-33 aboard two [[transports]]. 

===Splitting up===
Below, the children watch the X-wings pursuing the pirate ships, shooting one down. Neel says that Jod told him the X-wings are "bad" but Wim says they are "good." While the X-wings pursue the damaged transport, the children attempt to wave to them but the [[New Republic pilot|pilots]] do not spot them. While the other children are initially despondent, KB reassures them that she has memorized the [[hyperspace]] coordinates to At Attin. Fern thinks that they can climb the cliffside using a ladder to reach their ship ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', which lies on top of the cliff. However, KB thinks this is impossible and walks away. 

Fern speaks with KB in private. Fern believes that climbing up the cliffside is the only way to reach their ship but KB thinks they should consider other options. Before Fern can respond, KB criticizes her friend for not listening to her. Their conversation is interrupted by the boys, who alert them to the arrival of several [[trash crab]]s. Fern is suspicious of the crabs but Wim thinks that the crabs are friendly and intelligent. Neel and Fern don't trust the crabs and the latter thinks that they should climb back up to the ship. However, Wim disagrees and a shouting match breaks out between him and Fern.

Neel attempts to defuse the situation by saying that they need to work together to get back to the ''Onyx Cinder''. Wim believes that the crabs can lead them to someone who can help them get back to their ship. KB decides to follow Wim. Fern is angry that her friend is siding with Wim and says that they are splitting up. KB agrees. Fern calls for Neel, who decides to follow her, reasoning that splitting into pairs makes the best sense. He promises to pick up Wim and KB once they have reached the ship. Wim counters that they will beat them to the ''Onyx Cinder'' first. The two pairs walk in opposite directions. 

===Escaping execution===
Meanwhile, the surviving pirate starship reaches a [[space station]]. [[Brutus]] pronounces [[Captain]] "Silvo" guilty and sentences him to [[death]] [[Spacing|by]] [[airlock]]. While the other pirates cheer, a [[Chaelt|female pirate]] reminds them of the "[[Right of Last Appeal]]" in the [[Pirate's Code]]. Brutus snarls in rage but [[Snobbius Snee|a]] [[Keteerian]] pirate reminds them that the Right of Last Appeal must be upheld per the rules of equal time. 

After Brutus sets a [[plasma]] [[hourglass]], Jod gives a speech offering to sate the pirates' hunger for treasure. He also speaks to Glerb and the [[human]] [[Kona]], promising them wealth and power. He claims that he can lead them to [[Tak Rennod]]'s treasure on [[At Attin]], which he claims produces an infinite supply of [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Before the hourglass runs out, Jod offers to lead them to abundant treasure while undermining Brutus' leadership. Brutus reluctantly spares Jod's life but warns his former captain that if his information turns out to be false, he will be thrown out of the airlock.

===Operating on KB===
Back on [[Lanupa]], two starships carrying barges full of waste release their cargo onto the snowy and rocky landscape below. While walking with KB, Wim asks if she chose to follow him because she believed that the trash crabs could help or because she was angry with her friend Fern. Wim then gets distracted, noticing a tiny baby trash crab wiggling out of the eye socket of a discarded [[droid]] and wonders if [[SM-33]] is okay. He turns and finds KB slumped on the ground. KB explains that she cannot move because her augments are corroded. She tells Wim to gather some droid components in order to repair her augments. Wim rushes to gather parts from the discarded junk.

Later, Wim shows KB the droid components that he has salvaged from the scrap heaps. As KB struggles to unwind a servo, she tells him to unwind the lighter wires. When Wim asks if she has done this before, KB says she has not done this operation outdoors before. When Wim asks why she did not tell Fern about her problems, KB replies that Fern sometimes doesn't live in the "real world." KB explains that since her accident, Fern always assumed that she could do everything that she could. 

When Wim remarks that it is good that Fern does not treat her differently despite her disability, KB replies that she is different. She asks Wim to pull out the resonator housing at the back of her head and remove the [[micro-fuse]]. While Wim operates on her augment, KB confides that she is not as physically strong as Fern thinks she is. When Wim asks why she doesn't raise the issue with her friend, KB replies that Fern is impatient and she is afraid of not having friends again. Wim invites KB to be friends with him and Neel. 

KB places the damaged micro-fuse in the sand while Wim melts the wires of the resonator housing using a small [[Blowtorch|torch]] KB had. Under KB's instructions, he pours the molten metal into the mold left by the micro-fuse into the sand, which hardens instantly. He then places the newly-forged micro-fuse replacement into the resonator housing and inserts it back into her head. After a moment, KB's head goes limp. Wim panics but the lights blink in KB's orbs. KB rises to her feet and explains that she survived a near-[[Death|system shut down]], to Wim's surprise. KB thanks Wim for saving her life referring to him as a [[Jedi]]. KB then follows the trash crabs, with Wim following after her.

===Rescue and reunion===
Meanwhile, Fern and Neel climb an old metallic hull. Neel, who is shorter than Fern, struggles to keep up. Fern sees a discarded piece of [[rope]] caught on a bolt. She uses the rope as a [[harness]] to pull Neel, allowing him to catch up with her. The two see three hovering trash scouts levitating the ''Onyx Cinder'' with cables. Fern reassures Neel that they will get out of this together and tells him to follow her. As a fourth trash scout attaches itself to the starship, the ''Onyx Cinder'' descends down the peak. Together, Fern and Neel jump onto one of the trash scouts, which they take over. 

Elsewhere, KB and Wim follow the trash crabs past frozen boulders. The smaller trash crabs lead the children to a giant trash crab, which wants to eat them. The smaller crabs surround them, preventing them from escaping. In desperation, Wim uses his [[walkie talkie]] to call Neel and Fern for help. They see the trash scouts dragging the ''Onyx Cinder''. Fern sees Wim and KB and brings their ship lower. This allows the other two to climb aboard the ''Onyx Cinder''{{'s}} hull. 

The enraged giant trash crab hurls a boulder at one of the trash scouts, knocking the scout droids and the ''Onyx Cinder'' off balance. The children land on the snow and hug each other. Wim thanks Neel and Fern for saving them, complimenting their [[pilot]]ing skills. Fern apologizes to KB for not listening while KB apologizes for keeping things from Fern. The two friends hug. They then hear an enormous [[scrapper barge]] approaching the downed ''Onyx Cinder'', which has landed in the rubbish dump below the slope. 

===Escaping with the ''Onyx Cinder''===
Before the scrapper barge can devour their ship, the children race down the slope and enter the ''Onyx Cinder''{{'s}} [[cockpit]]. KB starts up the starship and begins flipping the switches. However, the scrapper has latched onto the ship. KB exits the cockpit to start the [[engine]]s and tasks Neel with flying the ship. As the scrapper's claw grabs the ship's hull, Wim heads to the bubble turret and opens fire on the hulking vessel's claws. However, the claws are heavily shielded. Neel manages to fire up the engine while Fern raises the yoke. KB fires up the engines, allowing the ship to accelerate. 

With the engines overheating, Fern comes up with the idea of using the [[emergency hull demolition sequencer]] to tear off the ship's hull. Neel and KB remind them that SM-33 warned them never to touch it. As the scrapper barge begins devouring the ''Onyx Cinder'', Fern activates the emergency hull demolition sequencer. This causes the ship to break out of its thicker armored hull, revealing a sleeker design. KB puts out an engine fire with her [[jacket]] while Fern and Neel grin in the cockpit. Wim shouts with jubilation in the rear bubble turret.
